newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: EDI sells unit to Campbell.
newsitem.headline: EDI sells unit to Campbell.

text.p: Engineering group Evans Deakin Industries Ltd said on Monday it had sold the consumer products unit it acquired during its recent takeover of Clyde Industries to Campbell Brothers Ltd for A$26 million.

Evans Deakin said it had concluded a contract with Campbell Brothers for the sale of the Wolseley Castle business in Australia and the Consumer Products Division of Ajax Chemicals in New Zealand for a total consideration of A$26 million.
Wolseley Castle makes and distributes consumer household chemical products and represents the largest component of the Ajax chemicals division, a unit of Clyde.
The sale would be effective from December 2.
Evans Deakin said negotiations for the sale of the remaining chemical operations were proceeding with interested parties.
